'''Bravo Two''' was the callsign given to a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

[[Porro Dolphe/Legends|Porro Dolphe]] served as Bravo Two around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. [[22 BBY/Legends|Ten years later]], Dolphe escorted [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] [[J-type diplomatic barge/Legends|royal cruiser]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
